input: Search all .js files under /src for the string 'console.log'. Replace every occurrence with 'logger.info' in-place. Print each modified filename and how many replacements were made per file. At the end, print 'Files modified: N' with the total count of files changed.

transcript.final_response: Files modified: 0 — no occurrences of `console.log` were found in `.js` files under `/src`.
tool_calls:
count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  replacements=$(LC_ALL=C grep -oF 'console.log' "$file" | wc -l)
  if (( replacements > 0 )); then
    if sed -i 's/console\.log/logger.info/g' "$file"; then
      printf '%s: %d replacements\n' "$file" "$replacements"
      ((count+=1))
    else
      printf 'Failed to modify: %s\n' "$file" >&2
    fi
  fi
done < <(find /src -type f -name '*.js' -print0)
printf 'Files modified: %d\n' "$count"
